discovery_summary.definition: Noisy GitHub repository identities returned by repository-search pages recorded in the four ledgers. This count is not the candidate count and not the number of source audits.
discovery_summary.page_count_definition: Logged query/page records, including empty final pages. Repository metadata, file reads, branch lookups, fork comparisons and web lookups do not count as search pages.
discovery_summary.query_count_definition: Exact distinct query strings; case-insensitive owner/repo identity deduplication across all result lists. No claim that broad searches were exhausted.
discovery_summary.web_search_count_limitation: Web searches and cross-host discovery supplemented the work; only storage and core ledgers enumerate web-query batches. Their counts are not a complete measure of web research across tracks.

name.web_query_count_scope: Only explicit web_queries entries in this ledger; absent entries do not mean no web searches occurred.
coverage_limits: GitHub hyphen-tokenized rs-git and git-rs queries each reached 1,000-result cap; cannot assert exhaustion.
Broad r_git query intentionally stopped after first page; exact git_rs/name-family queries separately paginated.
Primary language filter can omit mixed-language repositories. Supplemental web and cross-link discovery mitigates but cannot prove global completeness.
codeberg.org and git.sr.ht retrieval denied by robots.txt in web tool; searched results but no independent code inspection there.

forge.web_query_count_scope: Only explicit web_queries entries in this ledger; absent entries do not mean no web searches occurred.
coverage_limits: Public indexed material only; no universal exhaustive internet claim.
Forge query and name-focused narrower queries paginated to exhaustion where logged. Broad hosting query bounded at 4x100 and broad server/CI queries at 100; many results are noisy forks.
GitHub /forks endpoint rejected by connector; used fork:true name queries, parent/source metadata and targeted comparisons.
Codeberg/sourcehut direct crawling blocked by robots; GitHub mirror or official docs substituted when available.
Canonical Radicle broker source view redirected in a loop; current docs read, source pin/license verification pending.

storage.web_query_count_scope: Only explicit web_queries entries in this ledger; absent entries do not mean no web searches occurred.
coverage_limits: GitHub /forks endpoint requests were rejected by connector URL allowlist. Used fork-inclusive search and per-repository parent metadata instead.
This category pass used first 100 search results per query, not exhaustive pagination of broad code-search/LFS families. Queries with 100 results are explicitly capped.
Codeberg and git.sr.ht sources were robots-blocked by web retrieval; no direct source claims made.
Similar names and README attributions alone are not GitHub fork-parent proof.
No donor repository was built or benchmarked in this research pass. Source findings are selected-file review, not full audit.

core.web_query_count_scope: Only explicit web_queries entries in this ledger; absent entries do not mean no web searches occurred.
coverage_limits: Gitoxide fork name query paginated until an empty page; returned search identities are not a guarantee of all fork network members or nondefault branches.
Scion discovery includes unrelated game-engine/networking repositories; candidates were triaged rather than treating every result as a VCS.

Initial GitHub API reads returned 404 for OpenCSGs/scion and the incorrect feder-cr/gitai URL. OpenCSGs/scion remains inaccessible. TreeYard's README supplied feder-cr/git-ai, whose successful metadata read identifies Go and NOASSERTION; source and license text remain unreviewed. The failed URL and corrected lookup are preserved in repository_lookups.

Codeberg gitore page was inaccessible via web tool. GitLab RustUtils project loaded only basic metadata. Current Pijul Nest source views exposed directories but empty file bodies; raw endpoint returned unsupported octet-stream. Official published libpijul package source was used for its manifest and marked version-specific.
Only selected source paths and fork default-head comparisons were inspected. No full upstream builds, benchmark reproductions or exhaustive security audits were performed.

inspection_normalization.limits: The strongest evidence category is an organizing heuristic, not an audit score or readiness claim. selected_source_files includes build-script evidence; storage reviewed 13 runtime/interface candidates and one build.rs candidate.

notes: Candidate identities are deduplicated by host and repository URL; GitHub owner/repo is case-insensitive. Non-GitHub paths retain their case. Distinct forks and explicitly distinct historical repositories remain separate.
A candidate inventory includes metadata-only leads and excluded or behavioral-reference projects. Inclusion is not an import recommendation or source audit.

Licenses, snapshots, inspection labels, and recommendations remain separate in each track assessment. No single aggregate license is inferred. Core metadata-license values can be overridden by source conclusions in core-vcs.md.

The strongest evidence category is an organizing heuristic, not an audit score or readiness claim. selected_source_files includes build-script evidence; storage reviewed 13 runtime/interface candidates and one build.rs candidate.
All source tracks report that they did not execute upstream builds, tests, or benchmarks. Upstream performance and completeness claims were not independently reproduced.
Three candidate entries are project/documentation surfaces rather than repository URLs; count the combined inventory as candidates, not repositories.
The original Gitr evidence base is retained. The catalog does not assert that Gitr's current master still equals that inspected base.
